description: Loose stone crunches underfoot, greyed with dust and old oil. A dead streetlight leans at the verge, and the wind carries grit that finds your teeth. Tyre tracks braid off into the haze. At the kerb, a storm drain gapes where its grate has been levered aside — a rusted ladder dropping down into the dark of the Under.

flags.gps_suggest_label: Two-Cell Supply — Grady has work for a fresh clone.

name: Ironside Street
